# Capacity planning sample dataset (synthetic)

**Synthetic demo data** for the `powerbi-developer` agent: fictitious people and projects. Generated by
`scripts/generate_capacity_sample.py` (seed 42). The CSVs are git-ignored; regenerate them with:

```
python scripts/generate_capacity_sample.py --seed 42 --out data/capacity_planning_sample
```

- Status date **2026-11-20** (Friday). History: 26 weeks from 2026-05-25;
  plan: 13 weeks 2026-11-23 → 2027-02-15. Weeks start on Monday.
- Unit: **hours**. Standard week 40 h; FTE = hours ÷ (40 × weeks).
- Model with the `pbi-project-capacity` skill. Friendly names: `fact_capacity.csv` → `Fact Capacity`,
  snake_case → Title Case (`available_hours` → `Available Hours`, `week_start` → `Week Start`).
- `team_key` / `role_key` on the facts are point-in-time: one data engineer moved from Platform to Data & Analytics
  on 2026-09-07. `dim_person` holds the current team and role as text only (no relationship).
- `person_key = -1` = Unassigned (role-level or pipeline demand); `project_key = -1` = Internal (non-project time).

## Tables
| File | Grain | Key | Rows |
|---|---|---|---|
| `dim_date.csv` | day (with week columns) | date | 335 |
| `dim_team.csv` | team | team_key | 4 |
| `dim_role.csv` | role | role_key | 6 |
| `dim_person.csv` | person (+ -1 Unassigned) | person_key | 41 |
| `dim_project.csv` | project (+ -1 Internal) | project_key | 13 |
| `public_holiday.csv` | location × date | location + date | 12 |
| `fact_capacity.csv` | person × week | person_key + week_start | 1,525 |
| `fact_demand.csv` | project × person/role × week × demand type | composite | 4,549 |
| `fact_timesheet.csv` | person × project × day × activity (history only) | composite | 18,320 |

## Definitions used by the generator
- `available_hours` = gross − holiday − leave − non-project (role's `default_non_project_pct`).
- `demand_type`: **Allocated** (named person, probability 1), **Unassigned** (approved, role only),
  **Pipeline** (not approved; weight by `probability`).
- Timesheets: `is_project_time = 1` on project lines; internal lines use `project_key = -1`. The current week is
  partly `Submitted` / `Draft`, so approved-only measures dip in the last week.

## Expected results
**Capacity gap by role, plan weeks** (available − allocated − unassigned − probability-weighted pipeline, hours;
negative = shortfall):

| Week start | Data Engineer | BI Developer | Software Engineer | Business Analyst | Project Manager | QA Engineer |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-11-23 | 35 | 17 | 117 | 40 | 29 | 38 |
| 2026-11-30 | 29 | 16 | 114 | 22 | 28 | 38 |
| 2026-12-07 | -61 | 12 | 116 | 21 | 28 | 37 |
| 2026-12-14 | -61 | 9 | 114 | 19 | 28 | 37 |
| 2026-12-21 | -61 | 7 | 64 | 2 | 15 | 20 |
| 2026-12-28 | -81 | -42 | 63 | 7 | 20 | 27 |
| 2027-01-04 | -86 | -38 | 106 | 21 | 28 | 39 |
| 2027-01-11 | -85 | -42 | 111 | 20 | 30 | 33 |
| 2027-01-18 | -8 | -54 | 113 | 15 | 28 | 39 |
| 2027-01-25 | -12 | -56 | 110 | 14 | 28 | 37 |
| 2027-02-01 | -10 | -54 | 108 | 17 | 29 | 37 |
| 2027-02-08 | -9 | -57 | 88 | 2 | 26 | 25 |
| 2027-02-15 | -12 | -54 | 115 | 14 | 30 | 40 |

- **Data Engineers** allocated 111%–120% of available hours in weeks 2026-12-07 → 2027-01-11 (Risk Model Automation starts).
- **BI Developers** go short from 2026-12-28 when the AI Analytics Pilot (pipeline, 70 %) starts.
- **Utilisation by team** (approved project hours ÷ available, history weeks): Data & Analytics 82%, Platform 57%, Application Development 78%, PMO 70%.
- **Timesheet compliance by week-start month** (all booked hours ÷ expected = gross − holiday − leave): 2026-05 96%, 2026-06 98%, 2026-07 98%, 2026-08 92%, 2026-09 98%, 2026-10 96%, 2026-11 99%.
  Dips in August and the last week of October. The current week includes not-yet-submitted days.
  Grouping by calendar day instead of week-start month gives values above 100 % in some months.
